responsibility: Declares the core data representation for GCC’s per-location warning suppression state. It defines nowarn_spec_t as a compact bitset of warning groups, the bitwise operations used to combine and test suppression classes, and the nowarn_map_t hash-map type plus global map declaration that back language-independent APIs for associating location_t values with warning-disposition metadata across diagnostic generation.
same_name_distinction: Defines the interface and core types for the gcc-diagnostic-spec pair: it declares nowarn_spec_t, its warning-group bit constants and bitwise operators, the nowarn_map_t type, and the external nowarn_map declaration. Unlike gcc-diagnostic-spec.cc, it does not perform option-to-group mapping or implement the functions that read and modify per-location suppression entries.
